data_provenance.basis: Note 25(a) EPU: weighted average number of Units = 803,415 '000 -> 803,415,000 absolute (post 10:1 consolidation)

Note 25(b): 'Diluted EPU is the same as basic EPU as there were no dilutive instruments in issue' -> diluted = basic 803,415,000. Corrected from 803,730,000 (which matched neither the weighted-avg basic nor units in issue 805,035 '000).

Method 1: Management & Property Manager fees paid/payable in Units, added back as distribution adjustments (Note A, Distribution Statement p129). Single 'Amount available for distribution to Unitholders' = 176,076; no separate cash-fee-deducted adjusted figure -> null.

100% payout, no retention: 'Total amount available for distribution' = 176,076 S$'000 (taxable 148,828 + tax-exempt 9,843 + capital 17,405; Distribution Statement p129, '000->absolute) is fully declared for FY2025 = DPU 21.914c x ~803.4m units. The statement has NO retention line and NO 'amount to be distributed' line; it instead rolls forward (less 'Distributions' 90,145 cash paid in-year -> closing reserve 85,931), so distribution_paid = net_distributable_income = 176,076. Retained for the year = 0. Note B 'Total distributions during the financial year' 167,921 is cash physically paid (mixes prior-year finals) - deliberately NOT used per the for-the-year-declared rule.

Phase-1 harmonization 2026-06-23: report discloses no distinct for-the-year 'amount to be distributed' line (~100% payer; only a figure equal to NDI or computed from DPU*units). distribution_paid set NULL to avoid asserting a fabricated retained=0; for-year distribution approximately equals net_distributable_income.
